label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new export tool on Windows is likely saving files with CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings instead of LF (`\n`). Since `text.split("\n")` leaves a trailing carriage return (`\r`) on every line, `splitFields` includes it in the last field of each row, causing column count validation to fail.
